inbox.badge: {count, plural, one {# approval waiting} other {# approvals waiting}}
panic.title: Stop everything?
panic.body: Kills {sessions, plural, one {# session} other {# sessions}}, pauses {schedules, plural, one {# schedule} other {# schedules}}, disconnects {channels, plural, one {# channel} other {# channels}}, and tells {clouds, plural, =0 {no cloud daemons} one {# cloud daemon} other {# cloud daemons}} to do the same. Nothing restarts until you resume.
panic.resumeBody: Check what was running before you bring it back.
panic.resumeN: {count, plural, =0 {Resume without agents} one {Resume # selected} other {Resume # selected}}
offline.banner: Offline. Showing what was cached. Approvals you make now are sent when you're back online.
demo.banner: Demo data. Nothing here is connected to a real daemon.
update.ready: A new version of beamhop is ready.
agents.loadErrorBody: The daemon didn't answer. Your agents keep running; this page just can't see them right now.
agents.empty.title: No agents yet.
agents.empty.body: An agent is a harness like Claude Code, in a sandbox, with its own Nostr identity. Start from a preset; you can change everything later.
agents.lamp.needs: {count, plural, one {needs you} other {# need you}}
agents.activeSessions: {count, plural, one {Working in # session} other {Working in # sessions}}
agents.deleteBody: Its config and Nostr identity are removed from this daemon{sessions, plural, =0 {} one {, and its running session ends} other {, and its # running sessions end}}. Transcripts are kept until retention ends ({days} days).
agents.cloneHint: Same harness, folders, sandbox and limits. It gets a new identity and joins no channels, so it starts quiet.
agents.cloned: Created {name} · stopped until you start it
agents.notFoundBody: It may have been deleted or renamed from the CLI.
agents.offlineSave: Offline. Changes can be saved when you're back online.
agents.save.title: Save changes to {name}?
agents.save.newSessions: Changes apply to new sessions. {count, plural, one {The running session keeps} other {The # running sessions keep}} the old settings until they end.
agents.reach.label: What {name} can reach
agents.reach.branch: Git folders: each session writes on its own branch beamhop/<thread>.
agents.reach.neverNote: beamhop always blocks these. No role can change it.
agents.reach.secretsSome: The agent sees placeholders. The broker adds real keys for: {hosts}.
agents.reach.secretsNone: No secrets. The agent never sees a key.
agents.ov.idleNow: {name} is ready and waiting for a message.
agents.ov.stoppedNow: {name} is stopped. Start it to answer messages and run schedules.
agents.ov.filesHint: Behaviour files the harness reads from the mounted folders.
agents.ov.filesNone: No CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md or GEMINI.md in the mounted folders.
agents.ov.fileNote: Read-only here. Edit the file in your editor; the next session picks it up.
agents.ov.nowhere: {name} isn't in any channel yet, so nobody can reach it.
agents.setup.harnessNeeds: {name} needs attention before sessions can start
agents.setup.modelHint: default uses the harness's own choice. People with reconfigure rights can switch with /model.
agents.setup.authKeyHint: Recommended. The key stays in your keychain; the agent only sees a placeholder.
agents.setup.authSubHint: Some subscription plans don't allow use on servers or by other people. Check the provider's terms.
agents.setup.mountsHint: Read-only unless you say so. Paths like ~/.ssh are always blocked.
agents.setup.noMounts: No folders. {name} can chat but can't see any files.
agents.setup.maxSessionsHint: Extra threads wait in a queue.
agents.setup.approvalTimeoutHint: The agent is told the request was denied.
agents.mount.branch: Each session gets its own branch beamhop/<thread>.
agents.mount.lock: Not a git repo: parallel sessions wait for a write lock.
agents.mount.unsafe: Parallel writes allowed without a lock. Sessions can overwrite each other.
agents.mount.strictLock: Strict profile: every folder is read-only.
agents.mount.folderHint: Type a path or browse. Only folders under your home directory.
agents.sandbox.reachHint: Everything {name} can read, write and talk to, compiled from its sandbox.
agents.sandbox.workspacePreview: Read-write where you allow it. {api} + {count} dev hosts (git, npm).
agents.sandbox.customPreview: Your own allowlist. Edit it in the Policy editor.
agents.sandbox.learningHint: For a while, blocked hosts and paths are logged as suggestions instead of failing silently.
agents.sandbox.learnBody: Requests outside the sandbox are allowed and logged so you can turn them into rules. Locked paths like ~/.ssh stay blocked. Turn it off once you've reviewed the suggestions.
agents.sandbox.suggestions: {count, plural, one {# blocked request is} other {# blocked requests are}} waiting for a decision.
agents.sandbox.moreHint: Domain allowlist, env vars, the roles matrix and findings live in the Policy editor.
agents.ch.title: Memberships · {count}
agents.ch.hint: Where {name} listens, what wakes it, and the role strangers get there.
agents.ch.none: {name} isn't in any channel, so nobody can reach it.
agents.ch.allWarn: Reads and may answer every message in this conversation.
agents.ch.revoked: Removed by the channel. beamhop never rejoins on its own.
agents.ch.idHint: The bot has to be in it already.
agents.ch.roleHint: What people get unless you granted them a role.
agents.ch.needId: Add the group or channel id.
agents.ch.badTarget: That id can't be used in a target.
agents.routes.title: Routes · {count}
agents.routes.hint: Conversations {name} may post across. Anything not listed stays where it started.
agents.routes.needMembership: Join a channel first; routes start where the agent listens.
agents.people.title: People · {count}
agents.people.hint: Roles on {name} only. Global roles are in Settings.
agents.people.ownerNote: owner · all agents · can't be changed here
agents.mesh.title: Mesh guardrails
agents.mesh.hint: Limits for conversations between {name} and other agents, so two agents can't loop or burn budget.
agents.mesh.allowNone: No trusted peers. Other agents are treated as strangers.
agents.mesh.turnsHint: Then a person has to reply before agents continue.
agents.mesh.peerBudgetHint: Each peer agent can spend up to {amount} tokens of this agent's work per day.
agents.public.title: Public
agents.public.label: Answer unknown senders
agents.public.hint: Strangers get the viewer role: strict sandbox, rate limits, secret scanning on every reply.
agents.public.on: Anyone who finds {name} can talk to it.
agents.sch.title: Schedules · {count}
agents.sch.hint: Runs {name} without a message: on a timer, a webhook, a file change or a Nostr event.
agents.sch.emptyBody: Have {name} post a morning summary, react to CI webhooks or tidy notes when a file changes.
agents.sch.removeWebhookBody: Calls to {path} will fail. Its signing secret can't be restored; a new webhook gets a new one.
agents.sch.explainWebhook: Runs when the webhook URL is called with a valid signature.
agents.sch.explainFile: Runs when a matching file changes inside a mounted folder.
agents.sch.explainNostr: Runs when a Nostr event matches the filter.
agents.sch.badTz: Unknown time zone. Use a name like Europe/Berlin or UTC.
agents.sch.custom: Custom schedule — check the next runs
agents.sch.pathHint: beamhop creates a signing secret and shows it once.
agents.sch.globHint: A glob inside one of the agent's folders, like ~/notes/**/*.md.
agents.sch.filterHint: JSON, as in NIP-01: kinds, authors, #t tags.
agents.sch.promptPlaceholder: Post a summary of open PRs and failing checks.
agents.sch.needPrompt: Tell the agent what to do when it runs.
agents.sch.ownerHint: Whose role and budget apply to these runs.
agents.sch.secretWarn: This is the only time beamhop shows this secret. Store it where the caller can sign requests. If it's lost, remove the webhook and create a new one.
agents.bud.limitsHint: When a limit is hit, running sessions finish their turn and new ones wait until tomorrow.
agents.bud.dailyUsdHint: You're notified at 80% and 100%. Empty = no limit.
agents.bud.rolesHint: Also apply, per person. Edit them in Policy → Roles.
agents.bud.retentionHint: Older transcripts and audit entries are deleted automatically.
agents.id.keyHint: {name} signs its own messages. The secret key stays in your OS keychain.
agents.id.noKey: No key yet. One is created on first start.
agents.id.nip05Hint: Needs a nostr.json on your domain.
agents.id.previewHint: Published as a kind-0 profile when you save.
agents.id.relaysHint: Where profiles and messages are published.
agents.new.title: New agent
agents.new.sub.preset: A preset sets who can talk to it, its sandbox and its budget. Everything can be changed later.
agents.new.sub.harness: Only harnesses that are installed and logged in can run {name}.
agents.new.sub.folders: Folders are read-only unless you switch them. You can also skip this: {name} will only chat.
agents.new.sub.review: This is everything {name} will be able to reach.
agents.new.name: Name
agents.new.nameHint: Lowercase, digits and dashes. Shown in channels and slugs.
agents.new.pickHarness: Choose a ready harness, or fix one first.
agents.new.noReady: No harness is ready yet. Run the command under one of them, then check again.
agents.new.lockedRo: {preset} never writes, so folders are read-only.
agents.new.noFolders: No folders yet. {name} will chat but can't see any files.
agents.new.created: Created {name} · it has its own Nostr key
